'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**The [[Israel Defense Forces]] detain two alleged terrorists attempting to cross the Gaza border into Israeli territory armed with a knife and a grenade. [http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/News.aspx/244902 (Israel National News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[West Wind Aviation Flight 280]]
**The [[Transportation Safety Board of Canada|Transportation Safety Board]] of [[Canada]] reports the aircraft departed with ice on it before losing height shortly after takeoff. The December 17 crash killed one and injured fifteen. [http://avherald.com/h?article=4b24de9e&opt=0 (''The Aviation Herald'')]
*A [[United States]] [[F-16|F-16C]] [[fighter jet]] crashes during a landing attempt at [[Lake Havasu City Municipal Airport]], [[Lake Havasu City]], [[Arizona]]. The pilot escapes via ejection and is hospitalised. [http://abc11.com/f-16-jet-crashes-in-arizona-pilot-in-good-condition-/3386957/ (ABC11)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2018 North Korea–United States summit]]
**[[Thailand]] expresses its interest in hosting the planned summit meeting between [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and [[North Korea]]n leader [[Kim Jong-un]]. [http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/thailand-host-trump-kim-summit-54685658 (ABC News)]
*[[France–United States relations]]
**[[Donald Trump]] meets with [[France|French]] president [[Emmanuel Macron]] to discuss the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|Iran nuclear deal]] along with economics and trading. [https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/international/173118-180424-france-us-wish-to-work-on-new-nuclear-deal-with-iran-macron (i24)] [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2018/04/24/arriving-state-visit-emmanuel-macron-highlights-differences-climate-trade-and-iran/545222002/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[United States]] energy developer [[Invenergy]] files for arbitration against [[Poland]] with the [[United Nations]] [[United Nations Commission on International Trade Law|Commission on International Trade Law]] over a dispute following construction of four [[wind power]] projects in the country. Invenergy claims Polish authorities are ignoring binding rulings by local courts. [https://www.windpowermonthly.com/article/1462975/invenergy-files-poland-suit-un-court (Wind Power Monthly)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2018 Toronto van attack]]
**Alek Minassian appears in court in [[Toronto]] charged with ten murders and thirteen attempted murders. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-43883052 (BBC)]
*[[Yahoo! data breaches]]
**The [[U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission]] fines [[Altaba]] {{USD|35 million}} for failing to disclose its 2014 data breach in a timely manner. [https://www.cnet.com/news/company-formerly-known-as-yahoo-to-pay-35m-over-massive-breach/ (CNET)]
*[[Crime in Italy]]
**Italian police arrest a Bosnian driver driving a van loaded with weapons bound for [[Barcelona]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2018/04/24/world/europe/ap-eu-italy-weapons-seized.html (''The New York Times'')]
*The [[Supreme Court of the United States|United States Supreme Court]] rejects a case brought by foreign nationals under the [[Alien Tort Statute]] attempting to sue the [[Arab Bank]] over terror attacks in [[Israel]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2018/04/24/supreme-court-denies-terrorism-victims-claims-against-arab-bank/438277002/ (''USA Today'')]
*A former MP from [[Poland]]'s [[Samoobrona]] party is charged with spying for [[Russia]] and [[China]]. [http://thenews.pl/1/9/Artykul/360142,Former-Polish-MP-charged-with-spying-for-Russia-China-report (Radio Poland)]
*[[Crime in Texas]]
**Three people are shot and critically wounded, two of them [[Dallas Police Department|Dallas Police]] officers and the other a security guard, at a [[The Home Depot|Home Depot]] in [[Dallas|Dallas, Texas]]. The suspected shooter, who was also attempting to shoplift merchandise, was arrested soon after. One of the police officers died from his injuries the next day. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/home-depot-shooting-today-critically-injures-two-dallas-officers-police-2018-04-24/ (CBS News)] [http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/latest-dallas-officers-shot-remain-critical-54716315 (ABC News)]
*In [[Lima]], [[Peru]], a 36-year-old man gets on a public transport bus and sets fire to the passengers, after spraying them with gasoline, leaving 10 people injured. The most affected, a 22-year-old young woman, was seriously injured and believed to be the target of the attack. [https://panamericana.pe/24horas/locales/244162-miraflores-sujeto-prende-fuego-pasajero-bus-transporte-publico (''Panamericana Televsión'')] [https://diariocorreo.pe/edicion/lima/capturan-sujeto-que-quemo-joven-dentro-de-bus-en-miraflores-815415/ (''Diario Correo'')]
*An alleged arson attack kills 18 in a karaoke lounge in [[Qingyuan]], [[China]]. A suspect is arrested. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/24/china-karaoke-lounge-fire-arson-suspect-caught-after-blaze-kills-18 (''The Guardian'')]

'''Science and technology'''
* [[Atmosphere of Uranus]]
** Scientists using [[infrared spectroscopy]] data from the [[Gemini Observatory|Gemini North]] telescope have established the presence of [[hydrogen sulfide]] in the clouds of [[Uranus]]. [http://time.com/5251988/uranus-hydrogen-sulfide-rotten-eggs-voyager/ (''Time'')]
